answer.integer_conversion: Not supported. Native retained states preserve half-point fatigue at T1, T2, T4, and T5, and the qualified package-03 runtime/canonical round-trip evidence already establishes fractional preservation. The public desktop handoff uses serializeRuntimeState -> currentGameStateJson -> deserializeState, while headless assigns runResult.nextState directly; retained cold qualification says those serialization paths preserve fractions after a306.
answer.different_legal_action: Both paths execute the same relevant legal combat actions: hv_4th_guards_tg plans at T3 and attacks Bancici at T4; hv_113th_brigade_tg plans at T5 and attacks Tasovcici at T6. Combat choice therefore does not explain the pre-T6 fatigue difference.
answer.nearest_supported_cause: The only identified non-combat writer capable of the observed 0.5 increments is applyFatigueRecovery. It reads buildFrontlineAssignedFormationSet(state), whose sole input is corps_front_sectors[*].assigned_brigade_ids. Native end-turn archives place both formations in a sector at every T1-T6 boundary. Headless T6 places neither in any sector. This proves differing sector-assignment state by T6 and identifies the writer/consumer seam, but the retained headless artifacts do not expose that membership at the earlier update-formation-fatigue phase, so the exact first assignment mutation cannot be named honestly.

earliest_fatigue_divergence.directly_observed: T6: headless fatigue is 2.5 / 1.5 and native fatigue is 3 / 3 for 113th / 4th Guards; all other fields inside those two formation objects are exact per the qualified review.
earliest_fatigue_divergence.strong_inference_not_direct_snapshot: At commander turn 3 (which evaluates the post-T2 state), headless fitness values equal the zero-fatigue reconstruction using the corresponding native T2 personnel/cohesion/equipment/supply operands: 0.8826825 for 113th and 0.883575 for 4th Guards, while native T2 stores 0.5 for both. The retained headless run has no T1 or T2 state save and its brigade_temporal_log omits these TG IDs, so this cannot be promoted to a byte-exact T2 state claim.
earliest_fatigue_divergence.first_known_upstream_difference: At T1 the Historical player path has RS control of Bukvik Gornji and Obadi because always_deny suppresses two RBiH paramilitary captures; n101 has RBiH control. That input-timing delta is exact, but retained evidence does not connect those remote controller changes to the southeast-Herzegovina sector membership mutation.
